text:
maya_support: Hi team — customer reported that their free-trial credits landed on a different workspace after they restored SSO/SCIM. They have two workspaces: ACME-main (org_987) and ACME-clone (org_987-clone). Credits are on org_987 but the customer is actively using org_987-clone. Can someone help transfer or reattach the trial? :frowning:

ben_am: Thanks, Maya. Can you paste the billing IDs and the customer email? We need the billing owner to authorize any transfer. :eyes:

maya_support: Billing owner is finance@acme.com, billing_id: bill_44a2, customer reported the sequence: they re-provisioned SSO after a backup restore which created a second org with the same display name. They think the trial grant hit the original org automatically. Attached the customer's note.

maria_cs: Quick q — was the trial grant issued by promotions service or via internal promo code? That affects whether we can move it without a finance ticket.

maya_support: It was a free-trial auto-grant (system onboarding flow), not a manual promo code. Customer didn't apply any code.

aj_infra: I can move credit units between orgs but need written approval from the billing owner (finance@acme.com) and an internal ticket for audit. If you can get approval, I will run the migration script. Example command I use: ```internal-billing migrate-credits --from org_987 --to org_987-clone --amount 500 --reason "SSO restore orphaned trial"``` Output will show new balances and a migration transaction id.

maya_support: I've asked the customer for the billing owner approval and pushed a note to them to reply in thread. Also filed a supportops ticket SUP-4921 and linked it here. deploy-bot: created ticket SUP-4921 and assigned to billing-ops. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Ticket SUP-4921 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4921 — assigned to billing-ops, priority P2.

ben_am: Once we have explicit approval, @aj_infra please proceed and ping me with the migration transaction id so I can update the contract. Also, check whether any entitlements (reserved capacity or dedicated seats) are tied to org_987; we may need a partial migration.

aj_infra: Will do. Also will verify there are no active dedicated commits on org_987 that would block moving units. If there are, I'll propose partial transfer and flag for finance.

maria_cs: If we need a temporary workaround while migration is scheduled, we can set up an invite for the customer's service account into org_987 so they can consume credits immediately (short-lived). That might reduce customer impact.

maya_support: Customer approved in email (forwarded): "Finance OK to move trial credits to org_987-clone, please proceed." I'll attach the email to SUP-4921.

aj_infra: Proceeding with migration now. Running: ```internal-billing migrate-credits --from org_987 --to org_987-clone --amount all --reason "SSO restore orphaned trial (SUP-4921)"``` Will paste transaction id when done.

aj_infra: Migration complete. Transaction ID tx_7c3e9. New balances: org_987: 0 trial units, org_987-clone: 750 trial units. :thumbsup:

ben_am: Thanks — updating billing records and closing SUP-4921 after verification. maria_cs, Maya — please confirm customer can access usage and run a quick smoke test.

maya_support: Customer confirmed they can consume tokens and tested a quick API call successfully. Closing loop with customer now. :tada:
